reviews.author: Ksenia N.
reviews.text: Just love Nelia's work with my eyebrows and lashes! She is really talented! Studio is cute and clean.

reviews.author: Marika Bykova
reviews.text: I would not trust anyone with my eye brows but OCHI! I am very happy with the service, professionalism and the quality! Would highly recommend this place for brows to be done!

reviews.author: Anastasiia Benko
reviews.text: Had the best experience with this place. Nelly did an amazing work with my lashes. I wanted a natural look with foxy shape. Very happy with the results. Also, the atmosphere is so soothing as if I was meditating the whole session, not doing my lashes. Highly recommend OCHI

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Nelson
reviews.text: Found Ochi from a recommendation on a local ladies group, and truly couldn't be happier! I'm fairly picky with my brows (bad experiences in the past), and she took time to hear me out and understand exactly what I wanted. SO happy with the results that I immediately booked another appt. ALSO, best part is that she recommended a lash lift service to me and I was blown away!!! I got so many compliments and I can't wait to get them done again. The two things I like most about her is she gives you genuine advice about what is best for you and appts feel like hanging with a friend.

photos.curation_note: All 12 photos visually reviewed via _sheet.jpg and individually before selection. Only finished results with open eyes, plus one clean studio interior shot and one hands-on process shot, were used. No owner selfies were present in the downloaded set.

brand_vibe: Warm, minimal, editorial beauty studio: cream/tan walls, black leather treatment bed with a modern lash-extension arm lamp, soft natural light. IG marketing graphics (Brow Architecture, Lash Botox) use a cream background with dark serif type, gold-adjacent tan tones. Chose a custom warm terracotta/clay palette (not one of DESIGN.md's 5 pre-set palettes, and distinct from other recent lash & brow builds): bg #fbf6f0 warm cream, ink #2e2019 deep umber, accent-deep #b5654a terracotta clay, accent-mid #c98868 warm clay, accent-soft #f0ddd0 soft peach-cream. Dark CTA/footer bands use a near-black warm umber gradient (#241209 to #180c06) instead of the exemplar's plum. Checked for palette collisions against mixnminxlashes (dark gold), etherealeyelashesfl (gold-ivory), belezalash (cream-mocha), lashesdeve (wine-berry), lashbloom (blush-rose) and salaslash (brown): terracotta clay is distinct from all of them.
